description: This is a PHP unit test class for the MyTimesheetItemAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases for the API endpoints related to timesheet items, including testing 'getAll', 'update', and verifying that 'create', 'delete', and 'getOne' functionalities are not implemented or are properly handled as exceptions.
external_methods: OrangeHRM	ests	he various methods from EndpointIntegrationTestCase such as createKernelWithMockServices, getMockAuthUser, registerServices, registerMockDateTimeHelper, getApiEndpointMock, assertValidTestCase

classes.name: MyTimesheetItemAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the MyTimesheetItemAPI endpoints related to timesheet items, including 'getAll', 'update', and ensuring proper exception handling for unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API endpoint for fetching timesheet items, using test data fixtures and mocking authentication.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the 'create' method is not implemented and correctly throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the 'update' API endpoint for timesheet items with appropriate fixtures and mocking.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that 'delete' is not implemented and properly throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that 'getOne' is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForGetOne' is not implemented and throws an exception.
